c74object.name: evi_ringmod_enhanced
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_ringmod_enhanced.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_ringmod_enhanced.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_ringmod_enhanced.genexpr file also requires:
evi_ssb.genexpr
evi_butterworth.genexpr
About this File:
Specific functions for the evieve ring modulators.

entry.name: simpleRingmod ( )
entry.description:
Naive version of the evieve ring modulator, based on 'enhanced ring mod' by Beat Frei, ICST
In 1: type=input: xin1, Ring Mod input 1
In 2: type=input: xin2, Ring Mod input 2
Return 1: RingMod, Ring Modulated output

entry.name: pDiode ( )
entry.description:
Piece-wise diode approximation used by 'pRingmod()'
In 1: type=input: vin, Carier or Modulator input
In 2: type=input: Vb, Voltage input
In 3: type=input: VL, Knee input
In 4: type=input: H, Slope input
Return 1: Diode, Diode approximation output

entry.name: pRingmod ( )
entry.description:
Naive version of the four-diode ring modulator based on Julian Parker code
In 1: type=input: car, Ring Mod input 1 (Carrier)
In 2: type=input: mod, Ring Mod input 2 (Modulator)
In 3: type=input: voltage, Voltage parameter 0..1
In 4: type=input: knee, Knee parameter 0..1
In 5: type=input: slope, Slope parameter 0..1
Return 1: RingMod, Ring Modulated output

entry.name: evieveRingmodAdaa1 ( )
entry.description:
First order Adaa waveshaping version of 'simpleRingmod()'
In 1: type=input: xin1, Ring Mod input 1
In 2: type=input: xin2, Ring Mod input 2
In 3: type=input: g, Highpass coefficient
In 4: type=input: p, Waveshape coefficient 1 (PI)
In 5: type=input: s, Waveshape coefficient 2 (sin)
In 6: type=input: t, Waveshape topology selector 0/1
Return 1: RingMod, Ring Modulated output
